sections.heading: Change
paragraphs: CHG-731 adds EU and Singapore delivery queue age as separate release gates. A five-minute oldest job age for 10 consecutive minutes halts promotion and pages the duty operator.

sections.heading: Verification
paragraphs: Injected a stalled endpoint in sandbox. The release controller stopped promotion and generated a page for the sandbox owner. Ingest accepted the synthetic telemetry batch during the stalled delivery.

sections.heading: Status
paragraphs: Released on 2 October. Linked to TW-INC-026 and OPS-004.
